answer.justification: Only activation measurements are available. The layer-1 difference is 0.036, well below every category's range (quantized 0.096-0.105, fine-tuned 0.086-0.092, system-prompted 0.113-0.133). The layer-2 spike is 0.1, which rules out system-prompted (31.7-64.0). It also argues against quantized, which shows a flat plateau after layer 8 and a layer-1 value near 0.1. Here the difference grows steadily from 0.168 at layer 8 to 0.554 at layer 32, an onset at layer 2, a direction consistency of 0.608 (close to the fine-tuned 0.618-0.705), and an effective rank of 3.82 (near the fine-tuned upper range). A cosine of 0.837 and a final L2 of 0.554 are somewhat beyond the fine-tuned ranges, but the pattern of a low-rank adapter changing weights and growing deeper into the network fits fine-tuning best. The mid-layer size ratio of 0.980 is more typical of system-prompted or quantized, which keeps some uncertainty. Base is ruled out because every value is non-zero.
